incidente.resumo: Facebook and Instagram were completely down for approximately an hour, along with other affected sites such as Tinder and HipChat; Facebook's statements attributed the outage to a change that affected its configuration systems. According to this third-party analysis, Facebook began allowing TCP connections again at approximately 11:05pm, with full service restored around 11:20pm.

passos.texto: At 10:10pm Pacific, TCP connections to Facebook timed out, which the authors attribute to Facebook's engineering team likely shutting off traffic; packets were dropped within Facebook's network, likely by an update to its Access Control List (ACL).
trechos: At 10:10pm Pacific on January 26th, TCP connections to Facebook timed out, as their engineering team likely shut off traffic.
During the outage, packets were dropped within Facebook’s network, likely by an update to their Access Control List (ACL).

motivo_confianca_baixa: causa_raiz: the only causal statement is Facebook's generic 'change that affected our configuration systems', so status vaga was chosen; categoria_causa configuration-error is a judgment call from that wording. The ACL update is described by the authors as likely and as part of shutting off traffic, so it was placed under mitigacao rather than root cause. duracao was computed from the 10:10pm start and 11:20pm full restoration (the text also says 'approximately an hour'). data_incidente is null because the text gives January 26th without a year.
